note: server COUNT(*) queries at the non-target completeness cone, run after the fetch when empty flux fields were found in rows the server had passed with flux_h_templfit > 5.0. Missing values are NaN, not NULL; PostgreSQL sorts NaN above every number, so a server-side 'flux > x' keeps NaN rows and 'point_like_prob < 0.7' drops them. A first attempt with the literal 1e30 returned HTTP 400 and is not counted.
